summary_en: Tender offer for Yamadai Corp. (7426) by Nice Corp. (8089) extended from 40 to 40 business days (13 Jul to 28 Jul 2026). Offer price ¥601/share. Minimum acceptance 402,600 shares. Purpose: full subsidiary. Board of Yamadai recommends acceptance. No change to price, minimum threshold, or terms; extension provides shareholders additional time to respond.
title_en: Notice of extension of tender-offer period for Yamadai Corp. (securities code 7426)
translation_en_brief: Nice Corporation (8089) announced on 13 July 2026 an extension of its tender offer for Yamadai Corp. (7426), a TSE Standard-listed company. The offer, which commenced on 2 June 2026 at ¥601 per ordinary share, has been extended from the originally scheduled 30 business days (closing 13 July) to 40 business days, with the new closing date set for 28 July 2026. The minimum share threshold remains 402,600 shares, with no upper limit. The stated purpose is to make Yamadai a wholly owned subsidiary. No change has been made to the offer price (¥601/share) or minimum threshold. The extension was decided after assessing shareholder subscription levels and near-term application prospects, to provide Yamadai shareholders additional time to make an informed decision on participation. Yamadai's board of directors has publicly expressed support for the offer and recommends that shareholders tender their shares.
